Merck (MRK) has reportedly been in talks to acquire Swiss biotech company MoonLake Immunotherapeutics (MLTX) for over $3 billion, according to the Financial Times.

Snowflake (SNOW) will buy startup Crunchy Data in an agreement valued at $250 million.

content.summary: US drug giant Merck & Co Inc (NYSE:MRK) reportedly approached Swiss biotech MoonLake Immunotherapeutics (NASDAQ:MLTX) with a bid exceeding $3 billion. While MoonLake turned down the initial offer, talks may be revived.
